'''Arfan Ramos''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and leader of the [[Corellian Jedi|Green Jedi]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|There is no death... only the Force.|His final words|<ref name="The Battle of Corellia" />}}
Born into a wealthy [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] family, Arfan Ramos had an affinity for [[The Force/Legends|The Force]] that was discovered at an early age. Instead of sending him to the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] for training, however, his family gave him over to the [[Corellian Jedi|Green Jedi]] of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]]--an enclave of Jedi who rejected the High Council's authority and placed loyalty to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] above all else.

Like most of the Green Jedi, Ramos focused primarily on philosophical studies and research into the non-martial uses of the Force. Over the decades, he distinguished himself among his peers and rose to a position of wise, contemplative authority. With the arrival of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the defection of the local government, however, Ramos recognized the time for pacifism was past, and he was quick to change the Green Jedi's focus. Strong in the Force and a confident and capable leader, he had willingly shouldered the burden that has been thrust upon him.

Master Ramos was later present on Corellia where he rallied against the Sith invasion of the planet.

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I'll bury you first!|Master Ramos to his attackers|<ref name="The Battle of Corellia" />}}
While he was a Jedi by principle, Master Ramos possessed a fiery temper and was quick to words of aggression. Multiple times during his final battle he angrily shouted at his foes or proclaimed their death would be his doing. His anger was enough to see both his students and his fellow Councilors express concern, often forcing him to quote the [[Jedi Code/Legends|Jedi Code]].

==Powers and abilities==
As a Master sitting on the Corellian Jedi Council, he possessed substantial ability in the Force. In battle, he wielded a yellow-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], eschewing the common green color sabers analogous to the Green Jedi. Combining his anger into sheer skill, he was a deadly opponent in combat.
